contexts.text: Such (Spirits) may be called deadly ulcers, whether they are in the chamber of the breast, in the pleura, the pericardium, the mediastinum, or the lungs.
The seventh degree of their vastation is described by the sore breaking out into pustules (). ( = filthy things with the derivative blasphemies. AC 7524.) AC 7530. AC 7531. AE 962:8.
A sore = the filthy things which are from evils...
That sores = filthy things with blasphemies. Illustrated.
These various kinds of sores are haemorrhoids, scab, itch, () which = so many kinds of falsities which are from evils. Nearly similar is the signification of sores on the knees and thighs ().
The sores of leprosy, as the tumour, the abscess, the pimple, the burning, the scurf, the tetter () also = such (falsities); for leprosy = the profanation of truth.
Like painful sores, which cannot endure the touch [even] of Luke warm water, or a breath of air.
To lick the sores () = to heal their [falsities] by such means as are within their power.
The faces of some (of the infernals) are disfigured with pustules, warts, and ulcers.
That the gentiles were despised by the Jews (and were in falsities and consequently not in goods) is meant by Lazarus cast out at the gate of the rich man full of sores. AE 962:7.
Breaks forth like the matter from an ulcer outwardly healed.
Concupiscences are then shut in, like a closed ulcer.

An evil and noxious sore () = interior evils and falsities destructive of all good and truth in the Church. A sore, here = nothing else than evil originating from this doctrinal head, that faith alone... justifies and saves. ( = evil works and the derivative falsifications of truth. Explained. AE 962.)

The reason a sore = these things, is that the sores of the body originate from a corrupt state of the blood, or some other interior malignity; for so sores spiritually understood originate from concupiscences and their delights, which are the interior causes. The evil itself which is signified by a sore, and which in externals appears as delight, conceals within itself the concupiscences from which it arises, and of which it is made up. Explained.
(Thus) a sore = evil appearing in the ultimates or extremes, originating from internal malignity...
Sores, and wounds = evils in the extremes originating from interior evils, which are concupiscences. Illustrated.

They blasphemed the God of Heaven... for their sores () = that they could not acknowledge the Lord... on account of resistances from interior... evils originating from the dogma concerning faith alone... Sores = interior evils. AE 992.
He may be compared to an ulcer dressed with plaster, and afterwards covered with a thin skin, but which has nothing but foul matter within.
Sores = interior evils and falsities destructive of the good and truth in the Church.
Those who want to counterfeit holy things... are punished (by) an ulceration of the body: scab, leprosy, lice, and the like things according to the profanation.
On those who constitute deadly ulcers of the head, within the skull. General article.
A sore = works which are done from man, thus which are of his proprium, which are evil. Explained. AE 962:2. Illustrated.

It is from Divine order that where there are not good works there are evil works; and the latter are signified by the great and noxious sore in the earth, that is, in the Church, with those in faith alone in doctrine and life.
Sores = evil works which are from the proprium of man, and the consequent falsifications of truth and good.
Like a palliative treatment, by which an... ulcer is healed externally.
In this way only, is the ulcer opened and healed; otherwise it is only a palliative cure.
